The '''Fremond system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fremond III]].
